purpose: Seventh fresh generality batch. Two independent RealWorld (Conduit) reference implementations, chosen because they are maintained by third parties (not authored for this scanner) and exercise the two highest-value server stacks from the P1 backlog on entirely new code: an Express 4 + Prisma 4 TypeScript API whose responses are produced through cross-file mappers/DTOs and a four-argument error middleware (P1#1, P1#2), and a Laravel PHP API whose routes use string 'Controller@action' references inside a group namespace, Route::resource with only/except option arrays and slash-nested resources, constructor-injected Fractal-style presenters (not JsonResource) with item/collection/paginate wrappers, FormRequest validationData() payload wrappers, and named respond*() status helpers (P1#17). Every contract below was established by reading the pinned source and, where a runtime existed, running it natively; the scan output was never used to derive the baseline. The Laravel native runtime (PHP/Composer) is not available in this environment, so its contracts are source-verified and frozen as a vitest fixture (test/laravel-transformer-helper.test.ts) rather than executed; that limitation is recorded honestly in REMAINING-batch7.md.

scoring.notes: responseCompletenessDeterministic counts response-unknown/response-schema-unknown as incomplete; the interactive AI review closes those separately and is never scored as scanner correctness. A Laravel FormRequest whose own rules() returns a non-literal (dynamic) expression must keep body-schema-unknown; only authorization-only requests with no own rules() and an empty inherited ruleset are treated as bodyless. The Laravel GET / route renders the welcome Blade view (HTML) and is a real registered route, not a false positive, but is excluded from the JSON field-level contract review.

projects.baseline: Express 4 + @prisma/client 4 TypeScript Conduit API (package @api/source). main.ts mounts Router().use('/api', api) over four sub-routers and also defines GET / returning JSON {status:'API is running on /api'}. 20 operations total: GET /; articles: GET+POST /api/articles, GET /api/articles/feed, GET+PUT+DELETE /api/articles/{slug}; comments: GET+POST /api/articles/{slug}/comments, DELETE /api/articles/{slug}/comments/{id}; favorite: POST+DELETE /api/articles/{slug}/favorite; profiles: GET /api/profiles/{username}, POST+DELETE /api/profiles/{username}/follow; tags: GET /api/tags; current user: GET+PUT /api/user; auth: POST /api/users, POST /api/users/login. Response bodies are shaped by cross-file mappers/DTO over Prisma models (User/Article/Comment/Tag) with select/include projection: article payloads expose slug/title/description/body/tagList/createdAt/updatedAt/favorited/favoritesCount and a nested author {username,bio,image,following}; the whole Prisma row must not be leaked. Auth bodies wrap a user object; login/register wrap {user:{...}}. A four-argument error middleware maps UnauthorizedError to 401 {status:'error',message:'missing authorization credentials'} and HttpException (errorCode) branches to their status with an errors/body envelope. Query params (limit/offset/tag/author/favorited) are coerced but accept the framework's loose parsing and must not be narrowed solely from parseInt.

Laravel PHP Conduit API. routes/api.php wraps every action in Route::group(['namespace'=>'Api']) and references controllers by string 'Controller@action'; Route::resource('articles','ArticleController',['except'=>['create','edit']]) and a slash-nested Route::resource('articles/{article}/comments','CommentController',['only'=>['index','store','destroy']]) with singular bindings {article}/{comment}; routes/web.php adds GET / rendering the welcome Blade view (HTML). 22 operations total (21 JSON + the HTML welcome route): POST users/login, POST users, GET user, PUT user, PATCH user; GET profiles/{user}, POST+DELETE profiles/{user}/follow; GET+POST articles, GET articles/feed, GET+PUT+PATCH+DELETE articles/{article}, POST+DELETE articles/{article}/favorite, GET+POST articles/{article}/comments, DELETE articles/{article}/comments/{comment}; GET tags; plus GET /. Controllers constructor-inject a Fractal-style presenter (App\RealWorld\Transformers\*, a plain abstract base with item()/collection()/paginate(), NOT Laravel JsonResource): item wraps {resourceName: transform(...)}, collection wraps {plural: [transform(...)]}, paginate adds {pluralCount: total}; resourceName is a protected string property (user/article/comment/profile/tag) and TagTransformer::transform returns the scalar value, yielding {tags:[string]}. Article transform nests author {username,bio,image,following} and exposes tagList as a string array, favorited/following as booleans, favoritesCount and Comment id as integers; image/bio are nullable strings. Requests extend an intermediate ApiRequest (extends FormRequest); LoginUser/RegisterUser/CreateArticle/UpdateArticle/CreateComment/UpdateUser override validationData() to wrap rules under a user/article/comment key; CreateArticle allows tagList as a bare 'sometimes|array' (any element type); DeleteArticle/DeleteComment only define authorize() with no own rules() and therefore carry no body. store() calls respondWithTransformer() with no status argument, so the success status is 200 per the base method default (not REST-convention 201); destroy() calls respondSuccess() returning 200 with a null body; respondFailedLogin() returns 422 {errors:{'email or password':'is invalid'}} where the inner value is a string, not an array; respondError returns {errors:{message,status_code}} with named respondUnauthorized/Forbidden/NotFound/InternalError mapping to 401/403/404/500.
